description: A composite multi-panel figure (panels a–i) made mostly of scanning electron micrographs of inclusions in the "1 #" sample of Fe-15Mn-Al-C low-density steel, with two sets of EDS elemental maps. Panels (a)–(e) are single-particle inclusions, each with a 4 µm scale bar: (a) labelled Al2O3, a dark elongated particle; (b) labelled AlN, an approximately polygonal particle; (c) labelled AlN, an elongated rod-like particle; (d) labelled MnS, an angular particle with a stepped notch; (e) labelled TiN, an angular particle. Panels (f)–(i) are composite inclusions: (f) Al2O3-MnS with a dark Al2O3 core enclosed in lighter MnS (arrows, 4 µm); (g) AlN-MnS showing clustered dark AlN particles attached to an MnS particle (4 µm), flanked by a 2×2 block of EDS maps labelled (g) Al (green), (g) N (green), (g) Mn (blue), (g) S (red); (h) TiN-MnS with dark TiN attached to lighter MnS (5 µm scale bar, the only non-4 µm bar); (i) Al2O3-AlN-MnS three-phase composite (4 µm) with arrows to AlN, MnS and Al2O3, plus six EDS maps labelled (i) Mn (orange), (i) S (yellow), (i) Al (cyan), (i) N (green), (i) O (green), (i) Fe (red). The group demonstrates that the 1# sample contains single Al2O3, AlN, MnS and TiN particles together with Al2O3-MnS, AlN-MnS, TiN-MnS and Al2O3-AlN-MnS composites with sharp internal interfaces. No numeric values are printed apart from the scale bars; the EDS map colour scales carry no units.
measured_quantities: EDS elemental surface distribution (map, no printed unit)

observations.observation: Panel (a) is labelled Al2O3 and shows a dark elongated single-particle inclusion on a lighter matrix, with a 4 µm scale bar.
Panels (b) and (c) are both labelled AlN: (b) shows an approximately polygonal/elliptical particle and (c) shows an elongated rod-like particle; both have 4 µm scale bars.
Panel (d) is labelled MnS and shows an angular single particle with a stepped notch; scale bar 4 µm.
Panel (e) is labelled TiN and shows an angular faceted single particle; scale bar 4 µm.
Panel (f) is labelled Al2O3-MnS and shows a dark Al2O3 region enclosed inside a lighter MnS body, with arrows separating the two constituent layers.
Panel (g) shows an AlN-MnS inclusion in which clustered dark AlN particles are attached to a lighter MnS particle, with the labels 'AlN' and 'MnS' printed on the micrograph.
The (g) EDS map block contains four maps labelled (g) Al (green), (g) N (green), (g) Mn (blue) and (g) S (red); no colour-scale bar or unit is printed.
Panel (h) shows a TiN-MnS composite inclusion with dark TiN and lighter MnS sharing a visible straight interface; this is the only panel whose scale bar reads 5 µm, all others read 4 µm.
Panel (i) shows a three-phase Al2O3-AlN-MnS composite inclusion with labels and arrows pointing to AlN, MnS and Al2O3 sub-regions, with a 4 µm scale bar.

The (i) EDS map block contains six maps labelled (i) Mn (orange), (i) S (yellow), (i) Al (cyan), (i) N (green), (i) O (green) and (i) Fe (red); the Fe map shows a dark inclusion-shaped region, i.e. Fe depletion at the inclusion.
The caption states that panels a–e show single-particle inclusions and panels f–i show composite inclusions in the 1 # sample.
The citing text states that Figure 1a shows an elongated Al2O3 inclusion with a length higher than 8 µm, a value not printed on the image.
The citing text states that Figure 1c shows the extracted elongated AlN inclusion with a size of approximately 12 µm, a value not printed on the image.
The citing text states that Figure 1h shows a TiN-MnS composite inclusion with a clear interfacial relationship between MnS and TiN, consistent with the sharp boundary visible in panel (h).

The citing text states that scanning the elemental surface distribution in Figure 1i reveals the composition of the composite inclusions, which matches the six co-localised EDS maps shown for panel (i).

subfigures.description: SEM micrograph labelled Al2O3: a dark, elongated single particle lying on a lighter matrix; 4 µm scale bar.
SEM micrograph labelled AlN: an approximately polygonal/elliptical single particle with a small bright corner feature; 4 µm scale bar.
SEM micrograph labelled AlN: an elongated, rod/ribbon-like AlN particle seen at higher effective magnification; 4 µm scale bar.
SEM micrograph labelled MnS: an angular single particle with a stepped notch on one side; 4 µm scale bar.
SEM micrograph labelled TiN: an angular, faceted single particle; 4 µm scale bar.
SEM micrograph labelled Al2O3-MnS: a composite inclusion with a dark grey Al2O3 region enclosed within a lighter MnS body, annotated with arrows and labels 'Al2O3' and 'MnS'; 4 µm scale bar.
SEM micrograph labelled AlN-MnS: a cluster of dark angular AlN particles sintered against a single lighter MnS particle, labels 'AlN' and 'MnS'; 4 µm scale bar.

2×2 block of EDS elemental maps of the AlN-MnS inclusion: (g) Al (green) shows a compact cluster, (g) N (green) is faint and diffuse, (g) Mn (blue) and (g) S (red) outline the MnS particle. No concentration scale or units printed.
SEM micrograph labelled TiN-MnS: a dark angular TiN particle attached to a lighter MnS particle with a visible interfacial boundary, labels 'TiN' and 'MnS'; 5 µm scale bar (the only non-4 µm bar).
SEM micrograph labelled Al2O3-AlN-MnS: a three-phase composite inclusion with arrows pointing to 'AlN', 'MnS' and 'Al2O3' regions; 4 µm scale bar.

Six EDS elemental maps of the Al2O3-AlN-MnS inclusion: (i) Mn (orange), (i) S (yellow), (i) Al (cyan), (i) N (green), (i) O (green) and (i) Fe (red, showing a dark inclusion-shaped void). Element maps are co-localised in the inclusion. No concentration scale or units printed.
